name: Hing Peda Mouth Freshener – 180gm
original_description:
Introducing Hing Peda Mouth Freshener by Zaarah Herbals, a timeless Indian confectionary delight expertly composed from a harmonious blend of natural components, featuring the distinctive essence of hing , also known as asafoetida, and sugar. Hing, renowned for its unique pungency and aromatic charm, holds a sacred position in traditional Ayurvedic medicine, serving as both a digestive ally and breath refresher. Presented in petite, bite-sized portions, Hing peda offers an enchanting fusion of sweet and savory notes, creating a refreshing and invigorating sensory experience. Designed for on-the-go indulgence, it stands as a convenient snack or dessert choice, available to elevate your spirits anytime, anywhere.

Benefits Hing Peda:

  • Perfect for promoting digestion and enlivening your breath post-meal.
  • A traditional Indian sweet meticulously crafted from natural constituents, starring hing (asafoetida) and sugar.
  • Hing, celebrated for its unique pungency and aromatic allure, is a venerable component in traditional Ayurvedic medicine, cherished for its role in aiding digestion and breath revitalization.
  • Hing peda is thoughtfully presented in small, bite-sized portions, intended for modest consumption.
Ingredients:
  1. Hing (asafoetida)
  2. Black pepper
  3. Dry ginger powder
  4. Amchur powder
  5. Sugar powder
